prerequisites.name: adb
prerequisites.detail: Android platform-tools; adb -s <serial> exec-out screencap -p and adb shell screenrecord

prerequisites.name: running emulator
prerequisites.detail: One selected emulator serial with the app already installed

prerequisites.name: build receipt
prerequisites.detail: A native-build receipt binds the installed APK to the source; capture alone does not prove freshness

disallowed: Physical devices (a probe-only path may be scoped later)
Selecting another device automatically when the configured one is missing
Installing or building through this descriptor
notes: screenrecord stops at 180 seconds and records no audio (researched limit; confirm on the pilot host)
Pull the recording with adb pull after the recording process this run started has exited
